decisions.reason: A startup accelerator draws little on the firm's recycling machinery expertise and is hard to assess, but it is cheap to run, still featured on the home page, and helps the firm scout new technologies, so it is likely retained for now.

The bio-based bitumen binder is further from the firm's machinery core and depends on material-science knowledge the firm must still absorb, but it is a declared flagship of a growing firm with a dedicated page, so management keeps developing it.

The infectious waste decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's modular WASTX plant know-how, is co-developed with an industrial partner, and is prominently featured both years, so the firm can interpret and improve it well.
